description: This file 'hardware.cpp' serves as the entry point for hardware initialization and configuration within a complex automotive firmware project. It includes functions for initializing various hardware modules such as SPI, I2C, ADC, CAN, LCD, and other sensors, as well as managing hardware-specific settings and configurations needed at startup.

methods.name: lockSpi
methods.description: Locks the SPI bus for exclusive access, ensuring no other SPI device uses the bus simultaneously.

methods.name: unlockSpi
methods.description: Unlocks the SPI bus after use, allowing other modules to access it.

methods.name: initSpiModules
methods.description: Initializes specified SPI hardware modules based on configuration flags.

methods.name: getSpiDevice
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the SPI driver object corresponding to the specified SPI device.

methods.name: initI2Cmodule
methods.description: Initializes the I2C subsystem with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: sendI2Cbyte
methods.description: Sends a byte to an I2C device at a specified address (stub implementation).

methods.name: adc_callback_fast
methods.description: ADC callback handling ADC samples, forwarding data for processing.

methods.name: calcFastAdcIndexes
methods.description: Calculates ADC sample indexes based on current engine configuration.

methods.name: adcConfigListener
methods.description: Updates ADC indexes when engine configuration changes.

methods.name: turnOnHardware
methods.description: Starts various hardware modules required at engine startup.

methods.name: unregisterPin
methods.description: Unregisters a GPIO pin if it differs from the previous pin, to reset pin assignments.

methods.name: stopSpi
methods.description: Stops SPI communication on a specified SPI device.

methods.name: applyNewHardwareSettings
methods.description: Applies configuration changes by stopping, unassigning, and restarting hardware modules as needed.

methods.name: initHardware
methods.description: Performs comprehensive hardware initialization at startup, including configuring pin modes, sensors, communication interfaces, and other hardware modules.
